rules: IF ITS NAME HAS TWO WORDS OR MORE
IF ITS NAME HAS MORE THAN 8 LETTERS
subs: Your country gets attacked if its name has the letter on the card. Its strongest neighbor does the job. Only one name will survive.
Rule one. If your country's name has the letter Z... you get attacked.
15 countries are marked. Brazil, Venezuela, Azerbaijan.
Rule two. If your country's name ends in stan... you get attacked.
4 countries are marked. Pakistan, Afghanistan, Turkmenistan.
Rule three. If your country's name has the word land in it... you get attacked.
8 countries are marked. Thailand, Poland, the Netherlands.
Papua New Guinea takes the Solomon Islands.
Rule four. If your country's name has two words or more... you get attacked.
29 countries are marked. The United States, North Korea, South Korea.
Rule five. If your country's name is longer than eight letters... you get attacked.
19 countries are marked. Indonesia, Bangladesh, the Philippines.
Rule six. If your country's name starts with an S... you get attacked.
11 countries are marked. Spain, Sudan, Syria.
Rule seven. If your country's name ends in I A... you get attacked. Big names are on this list.
23 countries are marked. India, Russia, Ethiopia.
Rule eight. If your country's name has the letter U... you get attacked.
23 countries are marked. Ukraine, Turkey, Peru.
Rule nine. If your country's name has the letter E... you get attacked.
21 countries are marked. Vietnam, Egypt, Eritrea.
Rule ten. If your country's name has the letter O... you get attacked.
16 countries are marked. Morocco, Angola, Jordan.
Rule eleven. If your country's name has the letter I... you get attacked.
13 countries are marked. China, Iran, Iraq.
Japan, Myanmar, Canada, Chad... survived every letter. Now they fight.
Final purge. Only the four strongest armies survive. Japan, Myanmar, Canada and Chad.
The final duel. Japan against Canada.
Japan is the last country standing.
